findings.message: Neither a usable row-level knowledge-time column nor a non-negative governed publication lag is available.
findings.remediation: Declare and validate a fully parseable knowledge-time column, or govern a non-negative publication lag before prototyping time-dependent features.
findings.risk: Without a usable knowledge timestamp or governed publication lag, a feature prototype cannot prove availability at prediction cutoff.
findings.title: Feature availability time is not governed

findings.message: 1 governed arithmetic identity check(s) have rows outside their declared numeric tolerance; the largest mismatch rate is 32.67%.
findings.remediation: Reconcile units and row grain for each failed identity, then repair the source or document and govern the correct identity before prototyping.
findings.risk: Feature levels or ratios may encode incompatible units, duplicated grain, or internally inconsistent source values.
findings.title: Governed arithmetic identity mismatch

excluded_numeric_identifier_time_columns.detail: Numeric natural-key, partition, identifier, and calendar/time columns are listed for boundary QA and excluded from measure distributions.

group_heterogeneity.detail: One stable governed entity/vocabulary axis, its 20 most frequent groups, and at most six governed numeric value columns; all analyzed rows contribute.
group_heterogeneity.name: group_heterogeneity

numeric_distributions.detail: Outliers are described with IQR and MAD rules and are not removed.
numeric_distributions.name: numeric_distributions

inferred_candidate_key.detail: Evidence only; it does not repair or override the registry contract.

co_missingness_pairs.detail: All rows; at most 12 partially missing columns, selected by missing count then name.
co_missingness_pairs.name: co_missingness_pairs

conditional_missingness.detail: At most 3 condition columns, 6 targets, and 20 levels.
conditional_missingness.name: conditional_missingness

co_missingness.reason: All frame rows were evaluated for the deterministically selected columns.

conditional_missingness.reason: Missingness is conditioned on bounded low-cardinality source segments.

numeric_validity.reason: Finite, NaN/null, Inf, zero, negative, and common sentinel candidates were counted.

string_sentinels.reason: Configured textual sentinel tokens were counted after trim/case normalization.

validity_summary.detail: Numeric sentinel counts are heuristic evidence only; values are never removed or declared invalid without a source-specific contract rule.

autocorrelation.reason: Lag one is over ordered observed timestamps and is not forced to a fixed calendar lag.

cadence_and_gaps.reason: Cadence and gaps were computed over all distinct observation timestamps.

distribution_drift.reason: Earliest and latest timestamp quartiles are compared descriptively; composition changes can mimic distribution drift.

regime_shifts.reason: Strongest bounded median split is descriptive change-point evidence; it may reflect composition or source-method changes rather than a physical regime.

seasonality.reason: No selected numeric series has at least 24 timestamps, two years, and six months.

categorical_associations.detail: All rows; at most 6 columns and 30 levels per column.

correlation_columns.detail: At most 20 non-constant governed numeric value columns in contract order; calendar/time identifiers are excluded.

correlation_pairs.detail: Pearson and Spearman are paired with effective pairwise sample size.
